annotations.title: News search API: current news articles on any topic as JSON

description: News search API: current news articles on any topic from the Brave news index, as JSON with title, URL, snippet, publisher and age, 1-20 results, optionally only from the past day, week or month. Results are for immediate use only (Brave API terms). Use when an agent needs the latest news or headlines on a company, coin, person or event. Example: q=bitcoin ETF. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

freshness.description: Only articles from the past day, week or month (default: any age)

q.description: News search query, at most 400 characters
